digest.component_or_area: git contention seam / store test suite
propositions: The test intermittently fails when two concurrent writer processes race on a shared git index during interleaved add/commit operations.
Each worker calls run_git_write separately for add and commit, and the per-store advisory lock does not serialize the pair, allowing a commit to consume the entire index contents.
When writer alpha commits after staging its file, git commits both alpha.txt and beta.txt, leaving beta with nothing to commit and rc=1 with empty stderr.
Worker assertions report only stderr and omit the git command name and stdout, making failures self-diagnosing.
The fix requires each worker to commit only its own pathspec rather than the whole index, ensuring each writer has a non-empty commit regardless of add/commit interleaving.
The test must continue asserting that both concurrent writers exit 0 through run_git_write and both commits appear in git log.
